subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with appropriate preposition.
stimulus: A good boy is always attentive (a) ______ his studies. He thinks (b) ______ his career. He is interested (c) ______ carrying (d) ______ his studies. He does not deviate (e) ______ the truth.
guide_solution: Prepositions: (a) to (b) of (c) on (d) on (e) from
